chunks.subject: AP World History
chunks.title: SAQ 1 — Secondary Source (3 points) — Set 1
chunks.content: AP World History SAQ 1 (Secondary Source), 3 points, one per part A/B/C. 'Identify' = a correct answer; 'Describe' = relevant characteristics beyond a mention; 'Explain' = how or why. Set 1 prompts: A [1] identify one claim the author makes about the effect of a development; B [1] describe one economic change in the Americas that resulted; C [1] explain one reason 'American Indians became victims of the discovery of America.' Common failure: for A, quoting rather than stating the claim; for C, describing an effect without a causal explanation.

chunks.subject: AP World History
chunks.title: SAQ 1 Set 1 exemplar — Sample 1A, 3/3
chunks.content: SAQ 1 (Set 1) scored 3/3 (A 1, B 1, C 1). Identified the author's claim, described an economic change in the Americas, and explained a reason with a causal link. Full-credit model.

chunks.subject: AP World History
chunks.title: SAQ 1 Set 1 exemplar — Sample 1B, 2/3
chunks.content: SAQ 1 (Set 1) scored 2/3 (A 1, B 0, C 1). Identified the claim (A) and explained a reason (C) but did not describe a valid economic change (B). Illustrates missing the middle describe part.

chunks.subject: AP World History
chunks.title: SAQ 1 Set 1 exemplar — Sample 1C, 1/3
chunks.content: SAQ 1 (Set 1) scored 1/3 (A 0, B 0, C 1). Earned only C (explained a reason). Lost A (did not correctly identify the author's claim) and B (no valid economic change). Illustrates a response that explains a cause but misreads the source's claim.
